disaster-response.name: Disaster response
disaster-response.description: Find matching satellite scenes for time-critical events, whatever the weather.

flood-mapping.name: Flood mapping
flood-mapping.reason: SAR sees through clouds and works at night, making it the strongest choice for rapid flood extent mapping.
flood-mapping.detail: Best for water extent, inundation boundaries, and emergency response after heavy rainfall.

wildfire-scar.name: Wildfire scar assessment
wildfire-scar.reason: Multispectral bands reveal burn severity and vegetation stress through spectral change.
wildfire-scar.detail: Best for comparing vegetation health and recently burned surfaces.

landslide-damage.name: Landslide damage
landslide-damage.reason: Combining radar texture with optical context helps separate terrain change from surrounding land cover.
landslide-damage.detail: Best when cloud-free context and surface-change evidence are both valuable.

environmental-monitoring.name: Environmental monitoring
environmental-monitoring.description: Read the pulse of forests, water, and protected landscapes from above.

forest-change.name: Forest change
forest-change.reason: Optical color and radar structure together provide a more reliable view of canopy change.
forest-change.detail: Best for disturbance, clearing, and forest condition over time.

water-quality.name: Water and wetland monitoring
water-quality.reason: Visible and near-infrared bands provide useful separation of water, vegetation, and sediment.
water-quality.detail: Best for lakes, wetlands, coastlines, and surface-water change.

coastal-change.name: Coastal change
coastal-change.reason: Radar remains dependable in coastal cloud cover and helps reveal shoreline structure.
coastal-change.detail: Best for shoreline movement and broad coastal surface patterns.

urban-agricultural.name: Urban & agricultural
urban-agricultural.description: Compare the patterns of fields, infrastructure, and the places where people live.

crop-monitoring.name: Crop monitoring
crop-monitoring.reason: Spectral bands expose crop vigor and seasonal differences across agricultural parcels.
crop-monitoring.detail: Best for crop condition, field boundaries, and vegetation patterns.

urban-growth.name: Urban growth
urban-growth.reason: Optical detail and radar structure together distinguish built-up growth from bare ground.
urban-growth.detail: Best for settlement expansion and changing infrastructure.

infrastructure.name: Infrastructure mapping
infrastructure.reason: Radar provides consistent structural signals across lighting conditions and moderate cloud cover.
infrastructure.detail: Best for roads, dense built-up areas, and large engineered surfaces.
